name: zira
description: Run Zira from your AI chat: ask about production data, check device health, build and schedule readings reports, manage tasks and set up vision devices.

interface.longDescription: Ask about your plant in plain words and Zira answers from your live data. Show how a machine performed last week, turn readings into an interactive report you can save, schedule and share, check the health of your device fleet, see and create tasks, start dashboards, draft forms, create data sources, schedule AI summaries, and set up Vision devices step by step with their datasets and models. Type /zira to see every action, or just ask. Zira signs in with your own account, sees only what you can see, and shows a preview before it creates or changes anything. Inspect supplied nail images locally with the bundled OpenCV tool. Use it in a Local thread on your computer, not a Cloud task. If Zira needs the free Node.js helper, it sets it up with you; image/model analysis also uses its own Python environment. Early access.
defaultPrompt: Help me get started with Zira.
